Chapter 6868: Found It

Chapter 6868: Found It

In Dark Realm, an immortal resembling a ghost statue opened his eyes, gazing through time and the dimension. The beats were fast and changed continuously, making it difficult for immortals to notice them.

“That legendary heart?” He murmured.

“We must obtain it.” The strongest immortals in Dark Realm gathered to discuss this matter.

“We cannot let Devouring Abyss and Fallen Ten find it first.” A gigantic immortal spoke.

“That person has returned.” An immortal with a feathered fan and a cloth hat spoke.

“...” This silence the group.

“What should we o then?” The ghost statue asked.

“We shall listen to you.” The other immortals viewed the statue, giant, and the man with the fan as leaders.

“Call out the Realm Lord?” The statue said.

“Where is he?” The man with the fan asked.

“Is communication possible?” One immortal asked.

The atmosphere became strange because Immortal Emperor Gu Chun was a strange ruler. No one knew his location, not even his strongest followers.

“Don’t look at us, we do not know either.” The ghost statue said.

Immortal Emperor Gu Chun has disappeared after taking Stygian over. The only reason people still feared him was due to the presence of Dark Desire.

“What should we do if that person comes?” Someone asked a key question.

“Dark Realm will still be Dark Realm.” The giant said.

“What if the order is for Devouring Alliance to take over Stygian? What should we do then?” An immortal stated something that was on everyone’s mind.

No one could respond. Eventually, the man with the fan said: “Continue to carry out the laws and Dark Desire.”

The others exchanged glances, not satisfied with the non-answer.

***

In a bottomless abyss, an immortal with a golden radiance ordered: “Find it at all cost.”

“For us or...” Another immortal said.

“Find it first and worry about other matters afterward.” The first immortal said.

The other immortals nodded in agreement after a brief moment of hesitation.

***

In Fallen Ten’s territory, the group was far weaker.

“The thing mentioned by His Excellency has finally appeared. Find it for a generous reward.” An immortal with an extinguishing light ordered the overlords to search for the heart.

***

The first immortal to notice it continued the search. Unfortunately, finding the exact locations proved difficult.

“Silent all this time, who did this?” The immortal wondered.

All this time, he has been searching for the heart. He didn’t care for anything in Golden Mortal World or Stygian, only this heart.

It stopped beating after the destruction of Golden Mortal World. Today, he was suspicious of its awakening.

“Another devilish genius understanding the Gate of Wisdom?” This was one guess.

He believed that to find the heart, one must open the Gate of Wisdom. Previously, when he saw the gate, a brat came out of nowhere and nearly activated the gate.

He forcefully suppressed the brat to seize the gate, nearly killing him. This brat was a monster with the greatest talent he had ever seen in an immortal.

Thus, he couldn’t let such a threat get away. He abandoned the gate and pursued the brat instead to avoid potential complication.

“No other immortal can comprehend the gate.” He contemplated.

Other apex immortals knew the existence of the world’s heart in Stygian. Unfortunately, its silence implied death.

He, on the other hand, thought it was still alive. The problem was not having the right method to find it.

Furthermore, the immortals capable of finding the heart have never visited Stygian.

“Perhaps Devouring Alliance can be useful here.” A terrible gleam flashed in his eyes.
